segments.text: Ok so, this is the quickstart page in the CopilotKit docs, for Vue with Deep Agents. And umm, I have implemented this page in my project.
This is my project, with the server dot ts, main dot ts and app dot vue from the doc, umm, only the port is changed.

Moving on to the demo. So I asked the chat which agent framework it is, and uh, it does answer, but from the built-in OpenAI agent, not Deep Agents. No step on this page ever connects a Deep Agents agent.
So the Vue quickstart link opens the Deep Agents landing page, all about React.
And the only code it shows is a Next.js route handler, export const post equals handler. That's not Vue at all.
So basically, the Vue steps are only in the markdown export, and they use the built-in OpenAI agent, never a Deep Agents agent.
So uh, please look into this and fix it.
